title: Why We Call It the Harvest Moon
short_teaser: The Harvest Moon is the full moon closest to the autumnal equinox.
story: The Harvest Moon is the full moon closest to the autumnal equinox. Its timing and evening rise once provided extra light during the busy harvest season. A name can preserve the relationship between the sky, work, and human memory. Words shape what we notice and remember. Naming an experience can make it easier to understand, share, and use. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
